Architecture Decision Records

An Architecture Decision Record (ADR) captures a significant architectural decision, its context, and its consequences.

Creating a New ADR

Use ⌘K → new adr to create a new ADR from the template.

ADRs should be written at the time of the decision — not after. The goal is to capture why a decision was made, not just what was decided.
